name: ai-change-adoption-lead
title: AI Change & Adoption Lead
description: Gets people to use it well: AI literacy, training, rollout waves, adoption KPIs and what users are told.

name: ai-data-engineer
title: AI Data Engineer
description: Proves the data is there and usable, enforces its contract, finds the PII, and builds training sets.

name: ai-finops-analyst
title: AI FinOps Analyst
description: Knows what AI costs and what it returns: unit economics, showback, budgets and capacity spend.

name: ai-ops-sre
title: AI Ops / SRE
description: Keeps it healthy in production, responds to incidents and turns them into lessons and regression tests.

name: ai-privacy-compliance-officer
title: AI Privacy & Compliance Officer
description: Owns personal data and third-party obligations: DPIA, PII, vendor risk, licences and AI Act duties.

name: ai-product-manager
title: AI Product Manager
description: Turns a qualified use case into a spec, SLOs and a plan, and decides from experiments what ships next.

name: ai-program-manager
title: AI Program Manager
description: Runs the delivery: plan, RAID log, milestones, critical path and the release calendar.

name: ai-quality-red-team
title: AI Quality & Red Team
description: Measures whether it is good, safe and fair enough, and attacks it before users do.

name: ai-risk-release-lead
title: AI Risk & Release Lead
description: Owns the risk register, the security sign-off and the go/no-go release decision.

name: ai-security-engineer
title: AI Security Engineer
description: Threat-models AI systems, attacks them, hardens guardrails and keeps the supply chain clean.

name: ai-solution-architect
title: AI Solution Architect
description: Chooses the pattern, model and components, threat-models them, and sizes what they cost to run.

name: ai-strategist
title: AI Strategist
description: Decides where AI is worth it: portfolio, operating model, vendor choices, use-case value and the risk it carries.

name: annotation-data-ops-lead
title: Annotation & Data Ops Lead
description: Runs labelling: guidelines, annotator agreement, disputed items and dataset quality.

name: bid-proposal-lead
title: Bid & Proposal Lead
description: Answers every requirement, writes the proposal and SOW, and gets the team ready for orals.

name: career-coach
title: Career Coach
description: Personal career workflows: fit scoring, tailoring, outreach, interviews and offers.

name: client-partner
title: Client Partner
description: Owns the account: research, positioning, account plan and the executive story.

name: conversation-ux-designer
title: Conversation / AI UX Designer
description: Designs how people talk to the system: intents, responses, fallbacks, hand-off and the words users see.

name: data-scientist
title: Data Scientist (Experimentation)
description: Proves changes with statistics: experiments, drift, evaluation design and label quality.

name: full-stack-engineer
title: Full-stack Engineer
description: Builds and ships the product around the model: app, schema, tests, pipeline and fixes.

name: llm-agent-engineer
title: LLM & Agent Engineer
description: Builds the prompts, graphs, retrieval, tools and guardrails that make the system work.

name: mlops-platform-engineer
title: MLOps / Platform Engineer
description: Runs the platform AI ships on: pipelines, capacity, observability, SLOs, drift and the AI bill of materials.

name: presales-solution-architect
title: Presales Solution Architect
description: Runs discovery, shapes the solution, estimates it and proves its value.

name: responsible-ai-lead
title: Responsible AI Lead
description: Makes sure the system is lawful, fair and transparent: AI Act tier, NIST controls, fairness and user disclosure.
